fields.description: The Horizon is the first residential tower presented within Sobha Central on Sheikh Zayed Road. One- and two-bedroom apartments use balconies and varied orientations to face the city, community and coastal skyline. The tower’s own plans distinguish standard layouts from variants with additional service space, so the largest total is not representative of every two-bedroom home.

overview: One-bedroom Type A varies slightly by floor. Larger two-bedroom variants add maid and utility rooms, while smaller plans have a different circulation arrangement. The development is on Sheikh Zayed Road near the JLT interchange; this does not place it inside JLT.
research.locationNote: Sobha Central, Dubai, as described in the developer’s own project materials. No nearby district is substituted for the project address.
research.priceNote: The own developer page fetched on 31 October 2026 advertises AED 1,920,000 from, subject to inventory availability. This is a published guide, not a checked available unit, valuation or binding offer. Other historical launch advertisements may use a different price or unit mix.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder gives 20% at launch, 40% construction and 40% handover. No current developer-issued payment schedule was linked on the official project page; confirm dates, fees and any promotional option separately.
research.handoverNote: The project’s own brochure prints ACD December 2029, agreeing with the portal. Anticipated completion remains subject to the unit contract.
